text_block_list.text:
But I know I gave it everything I got, so
no regrets
here.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: I'm relieved that you're not feeling down.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But there are some things I need
to reflect
on.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I was overwhelmed by everyone else's
intensity
and lost... This just goes to
show I still lack
experience.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I don't think I was less focused on
winning than
the others, but it's still
pretty frustrating!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list:
You can take all that energy and pour it into
the next race.

Let’s use that feeling as a springboard to future
success!

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, yeah! I can feel power welling up
inside me
again!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's pretty amazing. It must be
because
of your help, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It's giving me another kind of strength,
different
from what my muscles give me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'll put that power to good work next
time.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Yeah! All right, now I'm feeling inspired!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I can't keep on losing. Next time, I really
wanna
win!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Heh... Then it looks like we both know
what needs
to be done.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Will you spot me again, just like always?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
So... please keep on training me to be
the best I
can!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Fist bump! Yeah, that's what I'm talking
about!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
